answer: A post-hoc outcome-consistency audit compares each agent's discrete decision sequence (votes, prices, classifications) as a vector. The pairwise correlation matrix shows a structural dune of mutual information among duplicate actors. Flag if cluster likelihood under an independent null model falls below 0.001, then retroactively zero all accumulated rewards. The echo of that zeroing hits downstream contracts. Cost per attacker: every historical payout and future yield on the flagged set, plus the full plume of their past gains.
